posts.title: Implementing Active Ranking
posts.description: A core task in social choice is the allocation of fixed resources among a set of items: funding across projects, budget across priorities, prize money across submissions. The output are weights – percentages out of 100 which say how valuable each item is relative to the others. posts.title: The Pairwise Paradigm
posts.description: The Pairwise Paradigm Abstract: Pairwise methods are best thought of as composing a paradigm for turning scarce attention into robust allocation signals . With the right algorithms , interface , and audience , they can support the continuous funding of ecosystems at surprisingly low attention cost.
